import cv2
import numpy as np
import math

# obs_0045: pose x=0.6574, y=4.3658, heading=45.0

# sofa color is bluish-grey ~ BGR [120-150, 110-140, 100-130]

mask45 = (img45[:, :, 0] > 100) & (img45[:, :, 0] < 160) & (img45[:, :, 1] > 90) & (img45[:, :, 1] < 150) & (img45[:, :, 2] > 80) & (img45[:, :, 2] < 140)

# Let's find lowest row for each column:
bottoms = [np.where(mask45[:, c])[0].max() for c in range(xs.min(), xs.max()+1) if np.any(mask45[:, c])]
cols = [c for c in range(xs.min(), xs.max()+1) if np.any(mask45[:, c])]
idx_lowest = np.argmax(bottoms)
